trace_driven_change.finding: The App Router hydration runtime dominated mobile script evaluation even though the foundation shell had no interactive React state.
trace_driven_change.resolution: Keep the shell authored and prerendered by the App Router and Tailwind build, publish a validated no-hydration production shell, and retain one fixed progressive-enhancement script for the same-origin bridge health projection.

notes: Every final run used the locked Lighthouse 13.4.1 CLI in its own process and a fresh profile owned by pinned Chrome for Testing 152.0.7923.0 against the same production standalone build.

The exact reproducible gate is CHROME_PATH=<pinned Chrome for Testing executable> MENTAT_WEB_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<preview-port> npm --prefix web run lighthouse:gate; required CI runs the same script.
The gate verifies the exact browser version, parses six temporary raw reports, requires every category score to equal 100, emits compact metrics, and removes raw files and browser profiles afterward.
Required CI uploads a bounded owner-private failure summary with the active run and completed metrics when an audit fails.
Score arrays are ordered Performance, Accessibility, Best Practices, and SEO.
